macros.name: arrowheight
macros.doc: The length of the vertical line in the arrow is set by the length \arrowheight.

macros.name: arrowstrut
macros.doc: The \arrowstrut command before the example add some vertical space so that the upwards arrow doesn’t overlap the preceding text.

macros.name: mvlink
macros.doc: All of the \mvarrow commands have an alternative version \mvlink which simply links the words with no arrows.

macros.name: setarrowstyle
macros.doc: The arrow style itself can be changed using the \setarrowstyle command.
